folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B325: actual inventory corrections and source-fit scope
folds.body:
The complete core plan and earlier141-line sweep were content-reviewed, including all C1–C8, E1–E5, C/W/S/K tables, edition comparison, reading bundles and later acquisition follow-up. F5 already supersedes C1's missing-title row at file-presence level. Into theOutside's filename ambiguity and repositoryWIP/reviewed labels still do not certify internal edition or semantic reading. Old no-acquisition and not-found statements describe their own earlier scans, while later library capture owns its exact preparation state. No repeat source acquisition is selected by this reconciliation.

Keep distinct source roles: a rules subset is not a complete setting; a supplement may require a matching core; RPG, wargame, fiction and an edition-specific adventure provide different evidence. The WFRP preorder/banner observation was not proof of newest edition then and is not a current product check now. ArsMagicaFifthEdition and D&D5e are unrelated edition labels. System-local points, seasons, rests, inherited land and teacher requirements cannot be merged into one power rank or mandatory cost. Source-qualified exceptional/free routes remain available.

The October18 reusable constraint correctly narrows the earlier cross-world evaluation: a local native action and useful consumer can prove a selected local slice; crossing/return/failed-storage checks attach when that seam changes. Current AD51 and selected book-world priorities qualify the illustrative first-source reading order, while AD52 preserves real costs/time/choice when simplifying repeated study. No all-book queue, universal generator, tabletop runtime or automatic new ArsMagica/Warhammer world precedes useful progress. No primary page/PDF, sourcebook, private inventory, exact ownership, license or current product claim was reverified by this local review.

folds.heading: ## Content reconciliation B325: quest references, exact titles and search limits
folds.body:
All25 catalog rows, notes and gaps were content-reviewed. Retain V versus snippet-only U, mixed on-page/off-page status and approximate competing thread counts. V means the catalog's recorded opened-page mechanic, not a whole story or external rules-document reading. Grouped titles in rows14/25 are leads, not independently verified entries. Onlyquestfound is bounded discovery scope, not a universal absence result. Ongoing/dormant/ended and forum accessibility are October22 observations, not current activity or an acquisition recommendation.

The gap list incorrectly expanded a mirror name into a novel. The current library owner explicitly identifies ttks.tw as a site and names five separate books. The corrected gap uses their actual printed titles and leaves title-specific quest searches unperformed; the original faulty sentence is preserved exactly in the batch amendments. This is a source-identity correction, not a new web search, novel reading, coverage claim or recommendation to collect those stories.

The useful donor questions remain varied: actual held item/resource versus a bar, capacity versus control, calendar budget versus elapsed time, practiced method versus stat rank, digesting a potion versus gaining XP, and an optional role/background versus imposed morality. Point-buy, dice explosion, rank caps, mandatory XP allocation, corruption/sanity penalties, weight limits, gacha and death penalties are these fan adaptations, not canon rules or accepted balancing constraints. A crossover especially needs its own admitted premise. They cannot fill missing source laws merely by displaying a crunchy sheet.

Forum voting, omakes/art/discussion rewards and linkedGoogleDocs are social authoring practices, not authority to send posts, collect the user's real activity or grant character progress for private user history. A rule-heavy quest can suggest a useful UI/control or conditional procedure, but still depends on a human author for unmodeled choices. No thread body, off-page rules, live forum, source novel, private save, real-user profile, UI or game mechanic was read or changed by this local review beyond the title correction.
